chapter_mission: Begin Operation Roundabout planning in earnest; Saxan under growing political pressure; Lumiya's tasseled hem first glimpsed in the peripheral visuals.
chapter_turn: The Alliance's operational planning accelerates; the shadow antagonist enters the book's visible frame for the first time, even if unnamed.

scene_plan.purpose: Operation Roundabout planning session; Pellaeon and Niathal set kinetic parameters.
Saxan under political pressure; tasseled figure glimpsed peripherally at a Corellian checkpoint.

exit_vector: A silent figure in tasseled robes moving past a Corellian security checkpoint — the book's first glimpse of Lumiya in daylight.
notes: First Pinch window opens. Dur Gejjen reappears. The 'tassels' glimpse is structurally the reader's first identification of the dark enemy.
